fields.title: Density
fields.question: Estimate how many CD8+ T cells there are per mm² of stroma in this field.
fields.legend: red = CD3e, green = CD8a, yellow = CD3e+CD8a co-expression, blue = Hoechst (nuclei)

steps.title: Field
steps.text: The field is 112 × 112 µm ≈ 0.0125 mm².

steps.title: Compartments
steps.text: As in TIL scoring, I split the tissue into epithelium and stroma and leave out empty space (lumen, glass): epithelium about 27%, stroma about 70%, empty about 3%. The stroma is about 0.0087 mm².

steps.title: Cell identity
steps.text: A CD8+ T cell must be both red (CD3e) and green (CD8a), i.e. yellow. Red-only cells are CD3+CD8− T cells and are excluded: 60 red-only cells in the stroma.

steps.title: Count
steps.text: 38 yellow cells lie in the stroma.

steps.title: Density
steps.text: 38 / 0.0087 mm² ≈ 4365 cells/mm² of stroma.

steps.title: Epithelium

steps.text: CD8+ T cells are yellow (red CD3e + green CD8a); 0 red-only cells in the epithelium are CD3+CD8− and excluded.

steps.title: Intraepithelial vs stromal
steps.text: Intraepithelial means inside the epithelial nests. 5 CD8+ T cells lie inside the epithelium, at (659, 174), (697, 180), (781, 386), (936, 494), (944, 627); 2 more are in the stroma and do not count.

fields.title: Ki67 fraction
fields.question: Among the epithelial cells in this field, what fraction are Ki67+? Answer as a percentage.

steps.title: Epithelium
steps.text: The epithelium covers about 78% of the field.

steps.title: Denominator
steps.text: As in IKWG Ki67 scoring, only epithelial nuclei count: 90 epithelial nuclei.

steps.title: Numerator
steps.text: Any red nuclear Ki67 signal counts: 58 of these epithelial nuclei are Ki67+. 4 Ki67+ nuclei outside the epithelium are excluded.

fields.title: Ki67 source
fields.question: Are the proliferating (Ki67+) cells in this region mainly epithelial cells or non-epithelial cells?

steps.title: Epithelium
steps.text: The epithelium covers about 48% of the field, about 57 epithelial nuclei.

steps.title: Ki67
steps.text: Any red nuclear Ki67 signal, whatever its intensity, counts as positive: 13 Ki67+ nuclei.

steps.title: Assign
steps.text: Comparing positions with the H&E image: 12 in the epithelium, 1 outside it (stroma or lymphoid tissue).

steps.title: Decide
steps.text: The answer follows the counts, not the area: 12 epithelial vs 1 non-epithelial, so the Ki67+ cells are mainly epithelial cells.
